question: Should OpenClaw core support native per-task model hints in HEARTBEAT.md, or should heartbeat model routing remain per-turn and plugin-owned?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested native task boundary, while the existing before_model_resolve hook and ClawHub plugin path cover only whole-run routing; choosing native syntax affects public HEARTBEAT.md semantics, model precedence, and session-state behavior.

options.title: Keep routing per-turn/plugin-owned
options.body: Document that heartbeat ticks currently route as one model-resolved turn and use before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins for routing policy unless maintainers approve a native task split.

options.title: Add native HEARTBEAT.md task hints
options.body: Define model/provider task fields, split or group due tasks by effective model, and add docs/tests for precedence, timestamps, and session restoration.

options.title: Fold into scheduled-job routing
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42631 the canonical scheduled model override design and avoid a separate heartbeat-specific routing syntax until cron and heartbeat semantics converge.

recommendation.title: Keep routing per-turn/plugin-owned
recommendation.body: Document that heartbeat ticks currently route as one model-resolved turn and use before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins for routing policy unless maintainers approve a native task split.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history on the model-routing product boundary and plugin-owned hook seam used to compare against a native HEARTBEAT.md contract.
